kinds.d: Raw tilapia (Oreochromis and relatives), sold whole or as fillets.
Raw freshwater catfish, pangasius or snakehead, sold whole or as fillets.
Raw carp (Cyprinus carpio and other carps), sold whole or as fillets; the centre of Christmas carp traditions in Central Europe.
m: Fränkischer Karpfen / Frankenkarpfen / Karpfen aus Franken PGI

kinds.a: Hecht · Barsch · yellow perch · pike-perch · walleye
kinds.d: Raw pike, perch or zander, sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
Raw whitefish of the genus Coregonus, sold whole or as fillets; tinned whitefish is with tinned fish.
Raw sturgeon or paddlefish flesh (Acipenseriformes), sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.

notes: Restraint only. 10 old kinds merged into six planned kinds (pangasius, catfish and snakehead into one; pike, perch and zander into one). All carp PGIs/PDO, Ban Phaeo snakehead GI and the whitefish GIs kept; 'Lough Neah' corrected to 'Lough Neagh'. Nothing dropped; no new kinds, no web research.
